title: TechRat: Learn Tech & Code
shortDescription: Practice tech questions, follow roadmaps, earn XP and level up your career.
fullDescription:
TechRat is a gamified way to study technology and prepare for tech jobs. Answer questions, follow roadmaps, earn XP, keep your streak and climb the leaderboards.

WHAT YOU GET
• 2,900+ multiple-choice questions in four difficulties (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), each with an explanation and an official reference
• Roadmaps for careers, languages, skills and best practices, from programming fundamentals to system design, AI engineering, cloud and DevOps
• Practice modes: Practice, Challenge, Random and Adaptive
• XP, global and per-topic levels, daily streaks, achievements and a daily challenge
• Global, weekly, monthly and topic leaderboards, with a privacy switch to hide yourself
• Study resources for every module: official docs, books, courses and articles
• English and Brazilian Portuguese

YOUR DATA
Create a free account to save your progress. You can choose a profile photo, change your password and delete your account and all its data at any time, from the app or at https://techrat.io/account/delete.

No ads. Privacy policy: https://techrat.io/privacy
